exact_call_site: TransformerLayer._forward_mlp -> MLP.forward (megatron/core/transformer/mlp.py:258) -> FC1 -> gated activation branch -> FC2
backend: Megatron core MLP.forward with bias_activation_fusion=false and use_te_activation_func=false; FC1/FC2 are adapter-provided TP=1 linear modules for the minimal replay, while the SwiGLU branch is the exact Megatron implementation

inputs.fc2_weight: part of surrounding MLP and excluded from activation-only replay

layout: contiguous row-major tensors; gate/up are interleaved according to Megatron MLP stride=2 and split with torch.chunk along the last dimension

dtype.replay: FP32 compatibility mode initially; V100 representative training mode should be FP16 after dependency validation

forward_semantics: When the unfused branch is selected: x_glu, x_linear = torch.chunk(intermediate_parallel, 2, dim=-1); SiLU(x_glu) * (x_linear + glu_linear_offset). If bias_parallel exists it is added before chunking.
backward_semantics: Autograd differentiates the real MLP path; fused Megatron bias_swiglu_impl has its own autograd Function, but is excluded from the initial compatibility replay unless its extension is available.

distributed_assumptions.process_group: not required for the local adapter path

v100_compatibility: SUPPORTED_WITH_FALLBACK: exact Megatron MLP Python activation path in FP32; FP16 is the next validation mode; no TE/FP8 dependency is claimed
replay_oracle: independent torch chunk + torch.nn.functional.silu + multiply implementation, compared against the output captured from Megatron MLP.forward activation path
open_questions: Whether the eventual production configuration enables bias_activation_fusion or TE activation
